jobDescription:
Frontend Developer (React) - Orbit Digital, Dhaka

We are looking for a Frontend Developer with 2+ years of experience building modern web applications with React and TypeScript.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain responsive, accessible user interfaces using React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
- Translate Figma designs into pixel-accurate, component-driven UI
- Integrate REST APIs and manage state with Redux or Zustand
- Write unit and integration tests with Jest and React Testing Library
- Optimise web performance (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting)
- Collaborate with designers and backend engineers in an Agile/Scrum team
- Participate in code reviews and maintain Git-based CI/CD workflows

Requirements
- Strong JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript skills
- Hands-on experience with React, Next.js, Redux, React Router
- Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, CSS Grid, Sass and Tailwind CSS
- Experience with REST API and GraphQL integration
- Familiarity with Webpack or Vite build tooling
- Knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG) and cross-browser compatibility
- Experience with Git, GitHub Actions and Docker is a plus
- Bonus: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Cypress, Playwright, Storybook, PWA

Education: BSc in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
